title: ggxy-ggZH-ampcache: reproduction package for gg → ZH at NLO+PS with charged-lepton and neutrino decays
description: Reproduction package for loop-induced gg → ZH at 13 and 13.6 TeV, with Z → ℓ⁻ℓ⁺ and Z → νν̄ summed over three flavours. Includes pinned builds, the exact amplitude cache (merged upstream), Born suppression, fixed-order and POWHEG event generation, scale and PDF weights, parton showers, STXS analysis, theory-uncertainty comparisons, and channel-specific LO+PS reweighting maps and reusable models. production/paper.sh defines the six production and validation sets; analysis and data-release scripts reproduce and package the results.
